content:
Maya K: heads-up, reproed a permissions regression — viewers can see 'Edit project' button after a role rename. repro steps below.

Jordan L: can you paste repro steps + which env?

Maya K: repro steps:
1) Create role 'viewer-v2' in console
2) Assign user U123 to role
3) Rename role to 'viewer' via UI
4) user signs out/in — still sees Edit button in project header
Tenant: rwd-test-42
Browser: Chrome 120
Screenshot: https://redwood.test/s/screenshot-role-rename.png

Ryan S: looks like frontend gating calls `canEditProject(user, project)` that matches by role *name*. If rename happened, backend stores role_id correctly but client is using cached name -> mismatch. :thinking:

Aleks (sec): quick question — is the role.rename operation recorded in audit logs with full metadata and KMS signature? we need chain-of-custody for compliance checks.

Maya K: audit shows event `role.rename` for role_id=rid_9876 at 2025-07-01T10:23:12Z, actor=maya.k, but the entry is missing `actor_ip` on that tenant. KMS envelope present but we should validate fields. Log link: https://logs.redwood/tenant/rwd-test-42/events?q=role.rename

Jordan L: running a query to find tenants with role renames in last 30d, will post results in 5m.

Ryan S: opened PR #4021 changing gating to use role_id and adding explicit client cache invalidation on rename. Added unit + e2e for rename flow. CI: https://ci.redwood/p/4021

deploy-bot: deploy triggered — PR 4021 -> canary/us-west-2 by @ryan

Sophia T: what's blast radius? product needs to know if we should notify customers / security posture.

Jordan L: preliminary query results: ~18 tenants had role rename events in last 30 days, ~42 distinct users showed edit UI post-rename. majority are labs/test tenants; a couple are small customers.

Aleks (sec): mitigation proposal:
- roll canary immediately
- force client role cache invalidation event (socket/force refresh) for affected tenants
- verify audit entries are complete and replay KMS signatures to ensure integrity
- if any customer data was modified under incorrect perms, triage for possible exposure

Maya K: agreed. Ryan — can you push hotfix to canary and add the extra audit metadata (actor_ip, request_id) to the rename event? also add a regression test for rename->signin flow.

Ryan S: pushing canary now, adding audit metadata patch to backend. ETA ~15m.

Maya K: I'll run a quick smoke across the 18 tenants once canary is up and post results.

Ryan S: canary deployed to us-west-2; invalidation event sent to affected tenants.

Jordan L: smoke results: 17/18 tenants show correct gating now; one tenant had an old client (v1.4.1) that didn't accept invalidation ping. reaching out to that customer.

Aleks (sec): make sure we capture a signed audit entry for the invalidation and the rename fix deploy. I'll kick off a short vuln triage thread if we find evidence of misuse.

Maya K: thanks all. will follow up in #incidents if anything escalates. :thumbsup:
